use: Measure viscosity indirectly from pipetting / weighing time (OT-2 platform).
simulation: Apparent viscosity from a rheology model, converted into pipetting / weighing data.
notes: OT-2 proxy viscometer: Mettler Toledo MS303TS balance (one slot base plate removed) + dispensing dish; driven by OT-2 measure_viscosity.
sources: Soh, Chitre, …, Hippalgaonkar & Wilson, Opentrons for automated and high-throughput viscometry, Digital Discovery 4, 711 (2025): 20–20 000 cP, ~8 % error, ~1.5 min per measurement
to_calibrate: Apparent shear-rate coefficient of the standard tip
Whether SI polling of the balance can reach 0.2 s

fit_power_law.description: Jointly fit a power-law + air-cushion model to all valid dispense curves of the latest sample (at least two flow rates) to get K, n and the viscosity at the reference shear rate

alternatives.model: Mettler Toledo / custom MS303TS + dispense dish (OT-2 proxy viscometer)
